syntheses.title: End-to-End and Mid-Level Autonomous Driving Methods
syntheses.body: Several methods for autonomous driving involve end-to-end learning approaches and mid-level representations. The CNN approach learns the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile (claim e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d), while ChauffeurNet uses an RNN with mid-level input and outputs driving trajectories (claim cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24). Mid-level representations enable training on real or simulated data and facilitate closed-loop simulation testing before deployment (claim 5fc32090-a96e-5352-b867-05795d95ae56). These methods generate steering commands from single front-facing camera images (claims 82d5df42-8220-51e7-a608-9993016f4e1c, 70eb8202-ac82-55fb-a95a-efb095234403).

syntheses.title: CARLA Simulator as a Comprehensive Platform for Autonomous Driving Research
syntheses.body: CARLA is an open-source simulator widely used for autonomous driving research, supporting development, training, and validation of urban driving systems (claims 6dde98eb-ff12-5785-926e-11fbb8cd299b, 2dedfe39-6dab-5024-be2e-997515e0211d, 95c1e45a-f076-5974-87ce-1ddf31a356f5). It provides free urban environment content, including layouts, buildings, vehicles, pedestrians, and street signs (claims 0488bcfc-4a7e-5848-a1d4-1e81239f8f55, 256972c1-eeae-5177-bc21-a23cc08d9a19, eaa96757-17f0-557c-9c27-40cae0a06932). CARLA supports flexible sensor suite specification and environmental conditions (claim b26241aa-3d3d-560b-9a47-d8c65f50bfa3) and provides exact locations and bounding boxes of dynamic objects (claim 5cb1f566-b5b8-59fc-bdf9-248b9b7cbf1a).

syntheses.title: Evaluation and Comparison of Autonomous Driving Approaches Using CARLA
syntheses.body: CARLA is used to study and evaluate three autonomous driving approaches: classic modular pipeline, end-to-end imitation learning, and end-to-end reinforcement learning (claim 34863bb0-827c-5405-a15d-f7229ca8985c). These approaches are evaluated in controlled scenarios of increasing difficulty using CARLA's metrics (claim 7e8db57a-25dd-55f8-9220-c289a62aea7f). The platform provides measurements of agent state and traffic rule compliance important for training and evaluation (claims 2ef71665-a8a3-556d-864e-59cd9b75ce1c, a4766e4b-52af-520a-b0f2-2c0267bf443f, 45e57524-d848-53c8-a93c-617d8480da8e).

syntheses.title: Historical and Dataset Context for Autonomous Driving Models
syntheses.body: Early autonomous driving projects like DARPA's DAVE involved sub-scale RC cars trained on human driving data including video and steering commands (claims 921c6021-1bc9-5882-bed7-218fbe19322d, 1f44da23-b078-5b48-9c3b-0f7f3315f522). ALVINN demonstrated end-to-end trained neural networks steering cars on public roads using smaller fully-connected networks (claims 443f6210-6468-59f8-8167-b719d39fc8fd, 64fadfcd-be98-5c13-b01c-6d0c033e603e). Training datasets include diverse roads, lighting, weather conditions, and effects like sun glare, collected with vehicles such as Lincoln MKZ and Ford Focus (claims 5b04c50f-7b96-5ddd-a0be-8eb2d45b4a96, 2f1c7b24-01c8-5804-972e-926509ffdc92, 1afead50-3221-58ef-9912-38613577c16d, f760d9d4-65ce-59e7-b492-c078a073c6c2).
